record.question: Which Union Minister presented the Interim Budget 2019?
record.explanation: Answer A: Piyush Goyal. The original Interim Budget 2019–20 speech is headed Piyush Goyal, Minister of Finance, and dated 1 February 2019. Accordingly Piyush Goyal presented this interim budget. Historical/source note: Interim Budget of February 2019; Nirmala Sitharaman presented the subsequent full budget in July. Reference: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/budget2019-20%28I%29/ub2019-20/bs/bs.pdf; https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?lang=2&reg=48&relid=187929. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
